acceptanceCriteria: Done means a one-package change selects well under half the module, with rule (d) still fail-closed. Measurements are in the BUILD-LOG entry of 2026-09-19.
body:
Migrated from docs/agent-memory/optimizations.md at v0.6.0 (entry dated 2026-09-21).

`internal/extevidence/mcp.go:190@cfb13fd9` parses for uniqueness then decodes with `DisallowUnknownFields`, and `mcpResponse` (`:149-171@79af857b`) calls `mcpObject`→`strictMCP` then `strictMCP` again, for both `initial` and `result` in `mcpExchange`; up to 32 MiB of JSON scanning per 8 MiB frame. Parse once and reuse.
title: extevidence: `strictMCP` parses each frame four times
